entities.name: Query protein 552 aa
observations: Sequence matches reviewed bacterial CTP synthases at 62.6–63.5% identity and 95.5–96.4% query coverage; likely CTP synthase, EC 6.3.4.2.
Homolog annotations describe ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, using glutamine or ammonia as the nitrogen source.

entities.name: UTP-to-CTP reaction
observations: Homology-based candidate reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+); Rhea RHEA:26426.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: Close homologs are annotated to de novo CTP biosynthesis within pyrimidine metabolism; CTP formation from UDP, step 2 of 2.
